rows.details: Northern Coalfields Limited (NCL), a Coal India Limited subsidiary
Prime Minister Internship Scheme (PMIS), Round 3, FY 2026-27
9 months from the date of engagement
Online only, via the PMIS portal
NCL establishments, Singrauli district, Madhya Pradesh

content_sections.heading: NCL PMIS Vacancy 2026 – Discipline-Wise Details
content_sections.text: NCL has notified 73 unfulfilled PMIS vacancies across six trade/discipline combinations, each carrying a monthly stipend of ₹9,000.

content_sections.heading: NCL Eligibility Criteria 2026
content_sections.text: Applying candidates must have completed and passed the prescribed qualifying degree or diploma (as listed in the vacancy table) from a recognized institute or university functional as of the crucial date, 01 April 2026.

content_sections.heading: NCL Age Limit
content_sections.text: Minimum age: 18 years Maximum age: 25 years Age is reckoned as on the crucial date, 01 April 2026, unless specified otherwise

content_sections.heading: NCL Stipend and Duration
content_sections.text: Selected interns will receive a monthly stipend of ₹9,000, credited directly to the intern's Aadhaar-linked bank account, with no deduction for social security benefits. The internship training duration is 9 months from the date of engagement. Under no circumstances shall this engagement lead to any claim for regular employment in NCL or Coal India Limited, and interns will not be absorbed into regular service under any circumstances.

content_sections.heading: NCL Selection Process
content_sections.text: Merit lists will be prepared by arranging the aggregate percentage scores of the qualifying examination (degree/diploma) in descending order, separately for each discipline. Tie-breaking criteria: candidates older in age (earlier date of birth) will be preferred; if a tie persists, candidates whose names appear first alphabetically in English (Roman script) will be preferred. Shortlisted candidates will be notified for document verification through the PMIS portal and the NCL official website.

content_sections.heading: NCL Social Security and Medical Benefits
content_sections.text: No deduction will be made for social security benefits; the stipend is credited directly to the intern's Aadhaar-linked bank account. Candidates must submit a Medical Fitness Certificate in the prescribed format from a Government Medical Officer before joining. No additional medical benefits will be provided by NCL.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply Online for NCL Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Ensure you have a valid email ID, mobile number, and an Aadhaar-linked bank account before starting registration. Visit the centralized PMIS portal at https://www.pminternship.mca.gov.in. Complete the online registration and application process as guided on the portal. Submit the application on or before the last date, 06-09-2026. Watch the PMIS portal and the NCL official website for shortlisting and document verification notifications. Candidates must apply exclusively online. No paper-based or hard-copy applications will be accepted.

content_sections.heading: NCL Recruitment 2026 – Important Instructions
content_sections.text: No TA/DA will be paid for attending document scrutiny or joining formalities. Interns will not be absorbed into regular service of NCL or Coal India Limited under any circumstances. Interns must make their own arrangements for accommodation, food, and transport during the training period. Leave entitlements will be governed as per the applicable PMIS guidelines. Suppression of facts or submission of false certificates will lead to immediate cancellation of candidature. For technical issues while applying through the portal, candidates may contact the HRD Department at [email protected] . For regular updates, candidates should visit the official NCL website under Menu > Career > Apprenticeship Training.

faq.question: Q1. What is NCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is an engagement of Interns by Northern Coalfields Limited under Round 3 of the Prime Minister Internship Scheme (PMIS) for FY 2026-27, covering 73 unfulfilled vacancies across six trades.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are there in NCL PMIS Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are 73 vacancies: 17 Foreman (Electrical), 16 Foreman (Mechanical), 13 Lab Technician, 9 Clerk, 9 Pharmacist, and 9 Overseer.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for NCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The last date to apply online is 06-09-2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for NCL PMIS Intern posts?
faq.answer: Qualification varies by trade: Diploma in Electrical or Mechanical for Foreman, B.Sc in Chemistry for Lab Technician, Bachelor of Commerce for Clerk, Diploma in Pharmacy for Pharmacist, and Diploma in Civil for Overseer.

faq.question: Q5. What is the age limit for NCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must be a minimum of 18 years and a maximum of 25 years of age, as on the crucial date of 01 April 2026.

faq.question: Q6. What is the stipend for NCL PMIS Interns?
faq.answer: Selected interns receive a monthly stipend of ₹9,000, across all six trades.

faq.question: Q7. How can candidates apply for NCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates must apply exclusively online through the PMIS portal at www.pminternship.mca.gov.in. No paper-based or hard-copy applications are accepted.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for NCL Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Selection is through a merit list based on aggregate qualifying-exam percentage for each discipline, with age and alphabetical order used as tie-breakers, followed by document verification.
